verdict.rationale: BAMF is a government service, so a documented system-to-system channel (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers) with a published enrollment path is a fair question. The evidence pack covers only human-facing information pages, service teams, and statistics, with no mention of any machine channel or enrollment process. The axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows the capability.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
